import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

# Ensure output directory exists
os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")

# Remove ID and high-cardinality string feature
drop_cols = ["id", "f_27"]
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in drop_cols + ["target"]]

# Extract base features
X = train_df[feature_cols]
y = train_df["target"]
X_test = test_df[feature_cols]
test_ids = test_df["id"]

# Atomic Improvement: Engineer second-order interaction features for top continuous columns
interaction_cols = ["f_0", "f_1", "f_3", "f_4"]
for c1, c2 in [(0, 1), (0, 3), (0, 4), (1, 3), (1, 4), (3, 4)]:
    X[f"{interaction_cols[c1]}_{interaction_cols[c2]}_prod"] = (
        X[interaction_cols[c1]] * X[interaction_cols[c2]]
    )
    X[f"{interaction_cols[c1]}_{interaction_cols[c2]}_sum"] = (
        X[interaction_cols[c1]] + X[interaction_cols[c2]]
    )
    X_test[f"{interaction_cols[c1]}_{interaction_cols[c2]}_prod"] = (
        X_test[interaction_cols[c1]] * X_test[interaction_cols[c2]]
    )
    X_test[f"{interaction_cols[c1]}_{interaction_cols[c2]}_sum"] = (
        X_test[interaction_cols[c1]] + X_test[interaction_cols[c2]]
    )

# Stratified train/validation split
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.2, stratify=y, random_state=42
)

# Low-cardinality features to treat as categorical
cat_features = ["f_29", "f_30"]

# LightGBM configuration optimized for fast convergence
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "n_estimators": 1000,
    "learning_rate": 0.1,
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "max_depth": 6,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "reg_alpha": 0.1,
    "reg_lambda": 0.1,
    "min_child_samples": 50,
    "random_state": 42,
    "verbose": -1,
}

# Train model
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**params)
model.fit(
    X_train,
    y_train,
    categorical_feature=cat_features,
    eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
)

# Evaluate on validation set
val_probs = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_probs)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Generate test predictions
test_probs = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Create and save submission
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "target": test_probs})
submission_df.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to submission/submission.csv")
